Yet your stay at River Inn feels worlds away, allowing the city to recede while the rhythm of the river lets you relax and recharge.

The River Inn of Harbor Town beckons with refined style warmed by the charm of Southern hospitality. The inn's boutique elegance encourages relaxation and comfort, with plush, luxurious décor.
